title: debería haber, es + adjective + que + mood, qué fuerte que, está bien que, es necesario que

cards.title: debería haber = there should be
cards.body: If neither ser nor estar fits, ask: does 'be' mean 'exist'? Then it's haber.

examples.en: There should be something to eat.

cards.title: es + adjective + que → mood tense
cards.body: With si (if) instead of que, there's no mood tense.

examples.en: It's terrible that you eat this.
It's terrible if you eat this.
It's possible that we'll go later.
examples.es: Es posible que vayamos más tarde.

cards.title: ¡Qué fuerte! = That's full-on!
cards.body: Fuerte = strong, and colloquially 'heavy / full-on'. Qué + adjective = how …: qué lindo, qué bueno. English sometimes uses 'should' for this mood feeling: 'how incredible that he should come'.

cards.title: está bien que = it's OK that
cards.body: Preguntar = to ask; responder = to reply.

examples.en: It's fine that you ask, but I don't need to answer.
examples.es: Está bien que preguntes, pero no es necesario que responda.

examples.en: It's important that we find it soon.
examples.es: Es importante que lo encontremos pronto.
